description: Labeled retrieval evaluation set for the bundled sample agreement (tests/fixtures/sample_eula.txt). For each policy category, `relevant_markers` are verbatim substrings that appear in the clause(s) a correct retrieval must surface. A retrieved chunk counts as relevant if it contains any marker for that category.

relevant_markers: may retain Customer Data indefinitely following termination
delete identifiable Customer Data within one hundred eighty
disclose Customer Data to its affiliates, service providers, advertising partners
engage additional Subprocessors at its sole discretion
retains all right, title, and interest in and to the Service
automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods
Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing by certified mail
shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Acme
IN NO EVENT SHALL ACME BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT
TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED
governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Cayman Islands
resolved exclusively by final and binding arbitration
